correctness.rationale: For q=p^s>=3, character sums over E have uniform fibres q/p over F_p^*, so W_d(chi)=L^d for trivial chi and zero otherwise. Primitive period-d words with weight-one product are isolated by Mobius inversion and character orthogonality, with exactly gcd(e,p-1) characters of order dividing e. Dividing by d gives primitive orbits and p^{v_p(d)} weighted rank, reproducing the stated divisor formula and its p-free density. Proper divisors d<=n/2 and e>1 imply the O(tau(n)^2 L^{n/2}) bound for n>=2, hence the subsequential limit for fixed m coprime to p. Independent direct exhaustive rotation-orbit calculation agreed with arithmetic formula for q=3,4,5, n=1..5, distinct from claimed published tables; not a proof for all n. Assumes Giraudin Theorem1(iv) L-function/orbit identity.
